fullDescription: A high-performance recruitment SaaS dashboard designed for interviewers. The aesthetic is clean, professional, and technical, utilizing a tech-blue and slate palette with 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for a modern feel. Suitable for HR tech, fintech, enterprise workflow management, and technical evaluation platforms. Key features include a three-column layout, detailed question cards with assessment guides, real-time timers, and progress-tracking timelines.
prompt:
## Resumo
WinTalent Interviewer Workbench: A structured, three-column recruitment dashboard featuring a left navigation/schedule bar, a central evaluation area with core assessment cards, and a right-side real-time monitoring panel with a timer and progress timeline.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a technical-professional aesthetic. Palette: Primary Blue (#2563eb, #1d4ed8), Background Slate (#f8fafc), Text Slate (#0f172a, #475569), Success Green (#22c55e), Warning Amber (#f59e0b). Typography: Primary 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (weights 400, 600, 700, 800), Monospace 'JetBrains Mono' for timers. UI elements: Corner radius 24px (3xl) for main cards, 12px (xl) for buttons. Shadows: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). Animations: Use cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for scale-up hover effects (1.02x) and a slow pulse (3s duration) for active state indicators. Icons: Thin-line Lucide-style icons.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Left Sidebar Navigation
Width 352px, border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Sections: 1. Header with '面试工作台' label in 11px bold caps tracking-widest. 2. Nav list: Active item #eff6ff bg, #2563eb text, 12px rounded-xl. 3. 'Today's Schedule' list: Cards with 11x11 avatar, status badges (blue/slate), and time stamps. 4. Bottom profile editor: 1px solid #f1f5f9, contains editable name/title fields and a pencil icon visible on hover.

### Main Header
Height 64px, bg: #ffffff, border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Left: Current candidate name in 18px extra-bold. Right: Action group with a 'Pause' button (Bordered, #475569 text) and a 'Submit' button (Solid #2563eb, shadow-blue-200).

### Candidate Profile Hero
Card with padding 32px, border: 1px solid #e2e8f0, bg: white, rounded-3xl. Features: 112x112 avatar with 4px white border, 30px extrabold headline, experience subtitle, and row of tech-stack tags (10px bold caps, bg-slate-50, border-slate-100). Right-aligned links for 'Resume' and social icons.

### Core Question Cards
Container with 24px gap between cards. Each card: Padding 32px, rounded-3xl, hover-border-blue-300. Layout: 1. Title section with 'Must Answer' badge (#eff6ff text-blue-600) and 18px bold text. 2. Star rating: 5-star group (#e2e8f0 default, #f59e0b active). 3. Nested Guide: bg: #f8fafc, 2-column layout ('Evaluation Points' and 'Criteria'), 11px bold slate-400 headers, 14px slate-600 list items with bullet points.

### Right Info Panel
Width 320px, border-left: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Sections: 1. Timer Box: bg: #2563eb, rounded-2xl, 36px extrabold mono text. 2. Progress Timeline: Vertical 1px line, status circles (Green check for done, Blue pulsing play for active, Faded for upcoming). 3. Tip Box: bg: #fffbeb, amber-900 text, 'Info' icon, 11px medium leading-relaxed.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Assessment Star Rating — A set of five stars used for immediate candidate scoring.
Five-star rating component using 'ph:star' icons. Default color #e2e8f0. On hover/click, fill icons with #f59e0b using 'ph:star-fill'. Add an 11px bold '点击评分' label in all caps tracking-widest beneath the stars.

### Assessment Reference Guide — Internal collapsible or static guide nested within question cards.
Box with bg-slate-50/80, 24px padding, 16px border-radius. Header: Icon 'lucide:book-open-check' + 11px bold '回答评价参考指导'. Body: Two-column grid. Left: '评估核心要点' with blue-400 dots. Right: '参考判定标准' with green-400 dots. Text size: 14px.

style.description: The style is characterized by its 'Technical Professional' theme. It uses a high-contrast palette of Deep Blue (#1e3a8a) and Slate (#f8fafc). Typography relies on 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI elements (10px to 30px) and 'JetBrains Mono' for data-driven numbers. Components feature large border-radii (24px/rounded-3xl), subtle shadow elevations (card-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)), and micro-interactions like 1.02x scale on hover.
